sentences.cn: 椰子是多种咖喱菜的基本成分。

sentences.cn: 速度是所有体育运动的基本要素。

sentences.c: The initial reaction has been excellent.
sentences.cn: 最初的反应极好。

sentences.c: My initial reaction was to decline the offer.
sentences.cn: 我最初的反应是要婉言谢绝这个提议。

sentences.cn: 他们从最初的市场测试活动中学到了许多。

sentences.c: The chick initially has no fear of man.
sentences.cn: 小鸡最初不怕人。

sentences.c: I initially dismissed the idea out of hand.
sentences.cn: 我起初不假思索地一口否决了这个主意。

sentences.c: Initially the system was offline for a number of days.
sentences.cn: 最初系统有几天没有联网。

trans.cn: Biện pháp, sáng kiến; chủ động, nhiệt tình; sáng kiến; quy trình đề xuất lập pháp của công dân (ở một số bang của Hoa Kỳ)

sentences.c: We have the initiative; we intend to keep it.
sentences.cn: 我们拥有主动权；我们想要保持主动权。

sentences.c: She was disappointed by his lack of initiative.
sentences.cn: 她对他缺乏主动性感到失望。

sentences.c: He believed in giving his staff scope for initiative.
sentences.cn: 他赞成给他的员工主动的机会。

trans.cn: Làm bị thương, làm bị thương; thiệt hại, tổn thương (danh tiếng, lòng tự trọng, v.v.); <cổ> đã làm sai (ai đó)

sentences.cn: 你不会刻意去伤害对手。

sentences.c: This could seriously injure the company's reputation.
sentences.cn: 这会严重损害公司的声誉。

sentences.c: When you use American weapons on your people, you injure us, too.
sentences.cn: 当你对你的人民使用美国武器时，你也伤害了我们。

trans.cn: 受伤的，有伤的；委屈的，受到伤害的
伤者，伤员（the injured）

sentences.c: Thankfully, she was not injured.
sentences.cn: 万幸的是她没受伤。

sentences.c: Luckily, she isn't injured.
sentences.cn: 幸运的是，她没受伤。

sentences.c: He injured his knee playing hockey.
sentences.cn: 他打曲棍球时膝盖受伤。

trans.cn_source: （身体上的）伤，损害；<法律>（对感情的）伤害，挫伤

sentences.c: She narrowly escaped injury.
sentences.cn: 她险些儿受伤了。

sentences.c: He is recovering from a knee injury.
sentences.cn: 他的膝伤正在痊愈。

sentences.c: The team has been weakened by injury.
sentences.cn: 这个队因伤实力减弱。

羡慕，赞美；钦佩（admire 的过去式和过去分词）

sentences.c: She admired his neat script.
sentences.cn: 她欣赏他写的一手好字。

sentences.c: We admired her exquisite handiwork.
sentences.cn: 我们欣赏她精致的手工艺品。

sentences.c: She was greatly admired.
sentences.cn: 她很受赞赏。

synos.cn: 羡慕，赞美；钦佩（admire的过去分词）

trans.cn: Đầu tiên, trước hết
trans.cn_source: 第一，首先

trans.cn: （用于引出一系列陈述）首先，第一

sentences.c: There are two reasons for this decision: firstly...
sentences.cn: 做此决定理由有二：第一…

sentences.c: It makes you look firstly at how you're treated and secondly how you treat everybody else.
sentences.cn: 它让你首先看别人怎样对待你，其次看你怎样对待别人。

sentences.c: No, firstly, I am superman.
sentences.cn: 不，首先，我是超人。

synos.cn: 首先（主要用于列举条目、论点时）；第一

trans.cn: 把…藏起来；躲藏
隐藏；遮蔽（hide 的过去式）

sentences.c: I hid under the bed.
sentences.cn: 我躲在床底下。

sentences.c: They hid me from the police in their attic.
sentences.cn: 他们把我藏在他们的阁楼上躲避警察。

sentences.c: At their approach the little boy scurried and hid.
sentences.cn: 当他们走近时，那个小男孩急忙跑开躲了起来。

trans.cn: 冰激凌
冰淇淋（同 ice cream）

sentences.c: The hottest icecream stand is at the Turkish Pavilion.
sentences.cn: 土耳其馆的冰淇淋摊最受欢迎。

sentences.c: But what good can a few rashers of bacon, a glass of wine and a scoop of icecream be doing for you?
sentences.cn: 可是，几片熏肉、一杯葡萄酒和一勺冰淇淋对你有什么好处呢？

sentences.c: All sorts of pastries and fillings imaginable are available, even moon cakes made from icecream and chocolate.
sentences.cn: 所有人们能够想到的口味，甚至夹着巧克力的冰激凌月饼，都应有尽有。

trans.cn_source: 包括

trans.cn: 包括在内的
包括；（使）成为……的一部分；允许（某人）加入活动（或同享特权）（include 的过去式及过去分词）

sentences.c: Entertainment included a ventriloquist.
sentences.cn: 演出的包括一名口技表演者。

sentences.c: The cruise included several days ashore.
sentences.cn: 这次航行包括几天陆上行程。

sentences.c: Many runners, myself included, are loners.
sentences.cn: 包括我本人在内的许多赛跑选手都是喜欢独来独往的人。
